snippet.description:
What makes a UPSC Mains answer easier to evaluate? AIR 22 Geetika Arora (UPSC CSE 2025) shares an important lesson from her experience evaluating Sociology Optional answer copies at LevelUp IAS.

She explains why long paragraphs can make answers difficult to read and how better presentation, clear headings and subheadings, pointers, a structured introduction and conclusion, and legible handwriting can improve answer readability.

Her key advice for UPSC Mains aspirants is simple: **make your answers easy to evaluate, improve their presentation, and always address the demand of the question.**

Watch this short for practical Sociology Optional and UPSC Mains answer-writing tips.

#UPSC #SociologyOptional #GeetikaArora #AIR22 #UPSCMains #AnswerWriting #UPSC2025 #LevelUpIAS #UPSCShorts
